pages.title: Node Shard
pages.text: Node Shards are glowing fragments of raw energy. Eat one in an instant and the Node effect surges through you for 10 seconds, granting Speed V and Jump Boost II. They stack up to 8 and are also needed for the Ring of Speed and some Somnium upgrades.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Node Shards grow as Node Crystals on the slimy trees and fallen logs of the Slime Forest. Break a Node Crystal to collect three Node Shards.
